semiconductor_relevance: Medium — J-solution provides specialized solutions for clogging issues in semiconductor production processes, particularly in exhaust lines.
summary: J-solution offers total solutions to prevent clogging issues in semiconductor and FPD industries, focusing on exhaust line management. Their products include the Powder Moving System and Exhaust Pressure Detector, which are designed to enhance production efficiency by addressing powder accumulation problems.

regional_presence.Korea: J-solution is the first in Korea to develop a measurement device for checking powder accumulation in exhaust lines.
